what: Microsoft makes Windows and Office (Microsoft 365) and runs Azure, the world's second-largest cloud platform. It also owns LinkedIn, GitHub, Xbox and a large stake in OpenAI.
customers: Almost every company and public organization in the world, developers, and consumers (Windows, Xbox).
money: cloud infrastructure and AI for companies; the fastest-growing part
Microsoft 365 and Copilot subscriptions, Teams, LinkedIn, Dynamics
Windows, Xbox and games, Surface, Bing ads
moat: Deep roots inside companies (replacing Office and Windows across a large organization is close to impossible), predictable subscription revenue and privileged access to OpenAI models.
risks: Very heavy AI data-center spending pressuring margins
opportunities: Operating margin of 47% with revenue growing about 18% last year
Azure is growing faster than the company as a whole and has AI demand it cannot yet meet
Its software is embedded in almost every large organisation, which makes price increases easy to pass
watch: Azure revenue growth and capital spending on AI data centres.
